hints.title: Difference Expression Analysis
hints.text: Observe the algebraic difference between the left sum and the right sum.

hints.title: Parity Invariant
hints.text: Since the difference simplifies to 2 * left_sum - total_sum, its parity depends only on total_sum.

hints.title: Total Sum Parity Decision
hints.text: If the total sum is even, every partition has an even difference. Otherwise no partition does.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Evaluates parity of total sum to determine count of valid partitions in a single pass.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Computing left and right sums explicitly for all partitions takes linear time but requires unnecessary operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Computes total sum with constant auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Derives parity invariant to reduce partition search to a constant time check after summation.
